privacy.title: Privacy notice for inquiries
privacy.intro: This notice explains what happens to the details you send through the inquiry form on this site, which is run by the consulting firm that uses Selah.
privacy.collect: Your organisation's name, sector, size and ownership type, the optional commercial registration number, your name, role, email and phone, the services you're interested in, your message, and your answers to the six self-check questions. We don't accept files through the form.
privacy.why: Only to respond to your inquiry, check it for conflicts of interest, and decide whether and how the firm can help. We don't use it for marketing and we don't sell it.
privacy.who: The firm's administrators, and the one consultant they assign to your inquiry. Other clients never see it.
privacy.technical: To stop abuse, we keep a keyed one-way hash of your network address and browser, never the address itself, and allow a few inquiries per hour from one address.
privacy.keep: If we start working together, your inquiry becomes part of your client record. Otherwise the contact details and message are erased 12 months after the inquiry is closed, or 30 days for spam. We keep only anonymous figures, such as sector and size, for statistics.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete your details by replying to the email you receive from the firm, or by contacting the firm directly. Requests are answered within 30 days, in line with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.

intake.suggestionsHint: On each inquiry, suggest consultants whose declared expertise matches it. It's a match for that inquiry, not a ranking of people.

kpis.title: Client KPIs
kpis.hint: Clients report their own key indicators on projects. Readings are the client's claims until the firm verifies them.
kpis.enabledHint: Switches KPI reporting on for every client project.
kpis.graceHint: Days after a period ends before a missing reading shows as not reported.

follow.title: Follow-through
follow.hint: How Selah decides that work needs attention.
follow.staleHint: An open action nobody has touched for this long shows as stale.
follow.checkinsHint: Days after handover, separated by commas. Up to six, from 1 to 730.
follow.checkinsInvalid: Use up to six whole numbers from 1 to 730, separated by commas.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: How often access is checked, and how many accounts a restricted client may have.
accounts.reviewHint: Each organisation's admins are asked this often whether their people still work there.
accounts.restrictedHint: A restricted client has client admins only, up to this many.
accounts.domains: The firm's email domains and people are managed on

records.title: Records
records.hint: How long some records are kept.
records.purgeHint: Days after handover before a minimal-records client's free text is cleared. 0 clears it at handover.
records.transcriptsHint: Days a transcript is kept after its summary is confirmed, from 1 to 90.

chats.title: Assistant chats
chats.hint: Chats quote client files, so they are kept only while they are needed. The audit log records each deletion, never what a chat said.
chats.archiveHint: Days without a message before a chat is archived, unless its owner keeps it. From 7 to 365.
chats.afterCloseHint: Days after a project is closed before its chats are deleted. 0 deletes them the next night.
chats.idleHint: Days after a chat's last message before it is deleted, even if the project is still open. From 30 to 730, and more than the archive days.

since.title: {n, plural, one {# action moved} other {# actions moved}} since your last visit on {date}
since.firstTitle: {n, plural, one {# action moved} other {# actions moved}} in the last 7 days

deviations.hint: Open actions and client KPIs that break one of the fixed deviation rules. The rules decide what counts; nothing here is a judgement of a person.
deviations.none: Nothing breaks a deviation rule right now.

overdue.name: Overdue
overdue.hint: The current due date has passed.

stale.name: Stale
stale.hint: No change, progress note or evidence for longer than the firm's stale period.

slipped.name: Slipped
slipped.hint: Two or more deadline changes were approved.

orphaned.name: No active owner
orphaned.hint: The owner is no longer an active member of the client.

kpi_not_reported.name: KPI not reported
kpi_not_reported.hint: A KPI period passed its grace days with no reading.

kpi_off_target.name: KPI off target
kpi_off_target.hint: The latest reading is in the red band.

detail.overdue: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} overdue
detail.stale: No change for {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
detail.kpi_not_reported: No reading for the period from {period}
detail.kpi_off_target: Off target for the period from {period}

trace.hint: How each piece of work connects: from what was found to the actions, the evidence and the reviews, and from the objectives to the KPIs meant to show progress.
trace.workHint: Finding, recommendation, action, then the evidence sent and each review.
trace.goalsHint: Each objective's KPIs, and the recommendations meant to move them.

handover.title: Handover
handover.hint: When the report is delivered, set the handover date. The firm then checks in with the client on the days in the firm's settings (30, 60 and 90 by default).
handover.hintDone: The report was delivered. The firm checks in with the client on the days below.
handover.sponsorHint: Told when an overdue action reaches the last escalation level. Named under client roles on the Team tab.
handover.dialogHint: Setting or moving the date creates or moves the check-ins that are still open.
handover.hintAfter: The report was delivered. The firm will check in with you over the following months.
handover.hintPending: The report hasn't been handed over yet.
handover.closeConfirm: Close this project? Close it when the engagement is over. Everyone's assistant chats about it are deleted after the firm's retention period (90 days by default).
handover.reopenConfirm: Reopen this project? Its chats are kept again until it closes.

engagement.title: How the client takes part
engagement.hint: Decides who at the client signs in and who records their progress.
engagement.changeTitle: Change how the client takes part
engagement.changeHint: Only the firm admin changes this. Each change is in the audit log.
engagement.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted. Accounts that don't fit the new mode must be switched off first.

full.label: Full
full.hint: The client's people sign in, record their progress and upload evidence.

restricted.label: Restricted
restricted.hint: Only the client's admins sign in. Their uploads stay private from the firm until they share them.

consultant_managed.label: Consultant-managed
consultant_managed.hint: The client has no accounts. The firm's consultants record progress and evidence for it.

blockers.accounts: {n, plural, one {Switch off its 1 account first.} other {Switch off its # accounts first.}}
blockers.nonAdmins: {n, plural, one {1 account is not a client admin. Switch it off first.} other {# accounts are not client admins. Switch them off first.}}
blockers.tooMany: A restricted client has at most {n} admin accounts. Switch some off first.
blockers.where: Accounts are switched off on the client's <link>people page</link>.

minimal.title: Minimal records
minimal.onHint: Shown in Selah as “{alias}”. Free text is cleared after handover.
minimal.offHint: For clients who want the firm to keep as little as possible.
minimal.offConfirm: Switch off minimal records? The client keeps its alias as its name, and what was cleared does not come back.
minimal.blocked: Only before anything is filed: this client already has contacts or files.
minimal.dialogTitle: Keep minimal records for this client
minimal.dialogHint: This cannot be undone for what it clears. Use it only when the client asked for it.

effects.name: The alias replaces the client's name everywhere in Selah.
effects.inquiry: The inquiry it came from loses its names, contact details, message and notes. Its statistics stay.
effects.files: No files, client contacts or assistant indexing for this client. Evidence is recorded as progress.
effects.purge: Free text is cleared a while after the project's handover. Titles, statuses and dates stay.

minimal.aliasHint: A neutral label, such as “Family office A”. Not the client's name.

departments.title: Departments
departments.hint: Optional. When on, work filed under a department is seen only by its people, the client's admins, the firm and the action's owner.
departments.hintClient: Optional. When on, work filed under a department is seen only by its people, your admins, the firm's team and the action's owner.
departments.count: {n, plural, =0 {No departments} one {1 department} other {# departments}}
departments.switchHint: Switched off, everyone on a project sees all of its work again. Departments and what is filed under them are kept.
departments.onConfirm: Use departments? Work already filed under a department becomes visible only to its people, the admins, the firm and the owner.
departments.offConfirm: Stop using departments? Everyone on each project will see all of its work again.
departments.listHintOn: The firm files actions under a department on the action page.
departments.listHintOff: Departments are off, so they don't limit who sees what yet.
departments.addHint: A department cuts across projects, such as HR or finance.
departments.switchOffConfirm: Switch off this department? What is filed under it stays there, but nothing new can be filed under it.
departments.head: Head
departments.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this department? They stop seeing its work, unless they can see it another way.
departments.addPersonHint: Active people of the client. The head also gets the second reminder for the department's overdue actions.
departments.everyoneIn: Everyone at the client is already in this department.
departments.emptyManage: No departments yet. Add one, then add its people.

errors.accounts: Switch off the client's accounts before the firm manages the engagement.
errors.nonAdmins: A restricted client has admin accounts only. Switch the others off first.
errors.tooMany: A restricted client has too many admin accounts. Switch some off first.
errors.minimal: Switch off minimal records before leaving consultant-managed mode.
errors.filed: Remove the client's contacts and files before switching to minimal records.
errors.member: Only active people of the client can join a department.
errors.notMember: That person is not in this department.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.hint: What each consultant can lead. Used only to suggest a lead for a new inquiry or client; you always choose.
expertise.hintOwn: What each consultant can lead. The firm admin records services and sectors; you keep your own languages and availability.
expertise.name: Name
expertise.availabilityHint: Switch off when too busy for a new client. Suggestions still list you, marked as not taking new clients.
expertise.notSetUp: Not set up. Without it, they are never suggested.
expertise.notSetUpAsk: Not set up yet. The firm admin sets it up.
expertise.dialogHint: Services and sectors they can lead, the languages they can run an engagement in, and whether they take new clients.
expertise.dialogHintOwn: Your languages and whether you take new clients. The firm admin records your services and sectors.
expertise.footnote: Sorted by name. This is for allocation, not a rating.

files.title: Files
files.descriptionFirm: Every file you can open in Selah, by client, project and where it came from.
files.descriptionClient: Every file you can open in Selah, by project and where it came from.
files.empty: No files yet. Files appear here once they are uploaded to an action, a meeting or a project.
files.emptyPick: No files of this client that you can open yet.
files.loadFailed: The files could not be loaded. Try again.
files.notCleared: This file is still being checked for viruses and can't be opened yet.
files.downloadFailed: This file can't be downloaded right now.
files.pickHint: Pick a file you already have in Selah. A copy is attached as evidence; the original stays where it is.
files.notShared: Only files shared between your company and the firm can be used as evidence.
files.move: Move the Files card: drag it, or use the arrow keys
files.uploadTitle: Add a file to a project
files.uploadHint: Checked for viruses, then stored privately. Choose who can see it; you can't change the project later.
files.departmentHint: Filed under a department, it reaches that team (and the firm, when shared). Otherwise everyone at your company with access to the project sees it.

errors.scanner: The virus scanner isn't available right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.infected: This file was refused: the virus scan found a problem.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.type: This type of file isn't accepted. Use PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, an image or text.
errors.generic: The file couldn't be added. Try again.

assistantState.needs_ocr: A scan: waiting for text recognition

files.ocrPages: Scanned pages it can't read yet: {pages}

findings.title: Findings
findings.hint: What the consultants found. A recommendation can answer one of them.
findings.addHint: Record a gap or an issue. A shared finding is visible to the client's admin and managers.
findings.answeredBy: {n, plural, =0 {No recommendation yet} one {# recommendation} other {# recommendations}}

rec.addHint: What the firm recommends and what shows it's done. Actions carry it out.
rec.title: Recommendation

action.addHint: A step someone at the client carries out. Keep it as a draft, or release it to its owner now.
action.title: Action
action.ownerNameHint: The firm manages this client, so the owner has no account.
action.noOwners: Nobody from the client is on this project yet. Add them on the Team tab before releasing.
action.evidenceHint: What the client should send so the firm can verify it.
action.releaseHint: They're told straight away. Otherwise it stays a draft: the owner isn't told, and only the firm can release it later.

errors.boardDate: A board decision needs the date it was decided.
errors.ownerTeam: The owner must be on the project team.
errors.releaseNeeds: To release it, pick an owner and a due date.
errors.jobTitle: This client keeps minimal records: give the owner's job title, not a name.
errors.department: That department is no longer active. Pick another one.
errors.finding: That finding isn't in this project.

fields.finding: What the consultants found. Optional. Rows under the same finding can leave it blank or merged.
fields.recommendation: Required on every row that has an action. Rows under the same recommendation can leave it blank or merged.
fields.rationale: Why the firm recommends it. Optional.
fields.targetOutcome: What should be true once it is done. Optional.
fields.priority: Low, medium, high or critical (in Arabic or English). Empty means medium.
fields.recDueDate: Optional. For example 2027-03-15, 15/03/2027 or a Hijri date such as 15/09/1448 هـ.
fields.requiredEvidence: What proves the recommendation was carried out. Optional.
fields.action: One action per row. Leave it empty for a recommendation that has no actions yet.
fields.owner: A person on the project team, by name or email. For clients the firm manages, the person's name (or job title).
fields.department: One of the client's departments, if it uses them. Optional.
fields.dueDate: Needed to send the action to its owner. Same formats as above.
fields.evidence: What the client must send, one item per line or separated by semicolons. Optional.

planImport.title: Import a plan
planImport.description: Findings, recommendations and actions from an Excel workbook or a Word document, into {project}.

upload.title: Choose a file
upload.hint: Excel (.xlsx) or Word (.docx), up to 20 MB. The file is checked for viruses and read; nothing is saved until you confirm.
upload.excel: Excel: one row per action, with columns such as Finding, Recommendation, Action, Owner and Due date. Headings in Arabic or English.
upload.wordTable: Word: a table laid out the same way.
upload.wordOutline: Word: headings and bullet points. Heading 1 is a finding, Heading 2 a recommendation, and the bullet points under it are its actions.
upload.templateHint: The Excel template has every column and a guide sheet. A plan exported from Selah can be imported back as it is.

map.title: Match the columns
map.hint: Selah matched what it could. Change any column that is wrong, and choose "Don't import" for columns to leave out.
map.truncated: Only the first 2,000 rows and 60 columns are read.
map.needTitle: Match at least the Recommendation or the Finding column.
map.outlineHint: Bullet points under a recommendation become its actions. Other paragraphs become the details of whatever comes before them.
map.noRows: No rows to import were found. Check the source and the heading row.

review.title: Review before importing
review.hint: Nothing has been created yet. Fix or leave out rows that need a fix, then import.
review.visibility: Who sees the new findings and recommendations
review.release: Send actions that have an owner and a due date to their owners now
review.releaseHint: They are told straight away. Every other action stays a draft, which owners aren't told about until the firm sends it.
review.editHint: Change what will be imported from this row. The file itself is not changed.
review.blocked: Fix or leave out {n, plural, one {the row} other {the # rows}} that need a fix first.
review.tooMany: One import takes at most 500 rows. Split the file, or leave rows out.
review.confirm: Create {findings, plural, =0 {no new findings} one {1 finding} other {# findings}}, {recommendations, plural, =0 {no new recommendations} one {1 recommendation} other {# recommendations}} and {actions, plural, =0 {no actions} one {1 action} other {# actions}} in this project? Imported records can be edited afterwards, but not undone as a batch.
review.done: Imported {actions, plural, =0 {the plan} one {1 action} other {# actions}}

issues.noTitle: The row has no finding or recommendation.
issues.badDate: {field} is not a date Selah can read.
issues.badPriority: Unknown priority; medium will be used.
issues.ownerUnknown: No one called "{detail}" is on the project team. The action will have no owner.
issues.departmentUnknown: No department called "{detail}". It will be left empty.
issues.departmentsOff: This client doesn't use departments; the department is ignored.
issues.tooManyItems: The evidence list has more than {detail} items.
issues.findingExists: The finding is already in the project and will be reused.
issues.recommendationExists: The recommendation is already in the project; actions are added to it.
issues.recommendationOtherFinding: The recommendation appears under another finding; it stays under the first.
issues.recommendationDiffers: {field} differs from an earlier row of the same recommendation; the first is kept.
issues.actionExists: This action is already in the project.
issues.actionRepeated: The same action appears twice in the file.
issues.staysDraft: Stays a draft: it needs an owner and a future due date to be sent.

errors.too_large: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.infected: The virus scanner refused this file.
errors.scanner: The virus scanner is unavailable, so files can't be read right now. Try again shortly.
errors.unsafe: The file looks malformed, so it wasn't opened.
errors.nothing: Nothing in the file looks like a plan: no sheet, table or headings.
errors.expired: This review has expired. Upload the file again.
errors.changed: The project changed while you were reviewing. Upload the file again to check the rows against it.

exports.unavailable: The PDF service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
exports.tooMany: You've downloaded a lot of PDFs in the last few minutes. Try again in a little while.

reportPdf.firmOnly: Firm only: this report has not been shared with the client.

phases.hint: Each phase or separately agreed scope is its own project, in the order agreed with the client.
phases.newHint: A phase, a follow-on scope or a retainer for this client. It stays a draft the client doesn't see until a signed engagement covers it; staff it from its Team tab meanwhile.
phases.title: Title
phases.days: {n, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}

projectPeople.title: Client people on this project

hint.full: Client managers and action owners see only the projects they're on, and only people on the project can own its actions. Client admins see every project.
hint.restricted: Restricted: only the client's admins have accounts. They see every project; add them here so they can own its actions.
hint.consultant_managed: Consultant-managed: the client has no accounts in Selah.

projectPeople.managed: Name each action's owner on the action instead, and keep the people you deal with in the client's contacts.
projectPeople.addHint: They get a notification and see this project from now on.
projectPeople.noCandidates: Everyone at the client is already on this project.
projectPeople.removeConfirm: Take {name} off this project? They stop seeing it, unless they are a client admin.
projectPeople.owns: {n, plural, one {owns # open action} other {owns # open actions}}

fileActions.shareWithClientConfirm: Share this file with the client? Everyone at the client who can open this project will see it. Sharing can't be undone; to correct the file, upload a new version.
fileActions.shareWithFirmConfirm: Share this file with the firm? The consultants on this project will see it. Sharing can't be undone.
fileActions.assistantOnConfirm: Let the assistant read this file? Its text is indexed on your server, and answers can quote it to people who can already open it.
fileActions.assistantOffConfirm: Stop the assistant reading this file? Its passages and summaries are removed from the assistant at once.
fileActions.assistantOn: The assistant can read this file
fileActions.assistantOff: The assistant no longer reads this file
fileActions.newVersionHint: Replaces {title} with the next version. The earlier version stays on record. The new one keeps the same project, label and department.
fileActions.newVersionHintShared: Replaces {title} with the next version, which the client sees too. The earlier version stays on record. The new one keeps the same project, label and department.

engagements.title: Signed engagements
engagements.hint: What the client signed. A project starts once an engagement covers it; until then it is a draft the client doesn't see.
engagements.noneWithDrafts: No signed engagement recorded yet. {n, plural, one {# draft project waits} other {# draft projects wait}} for one.
engagements.recordHint: Enter what the client signed. Tick the draft projects it covers: they become planned and the client's people can see them.
engagements.editHint: Correct what was recorded. The client stays the same.
engagements.deleteConfirm: Delete this engagement record? Only a record that covers no project can be deleted.
engagements.pageHint: A signed engagement and the projects and deliverables it covers.
engagements.signedSectionHint: The engagement is recorded with the client, and the first project starts under it.
engagements.coversHint: This client's projects that no engagement covers yet. A draft becomes planned and the client sees it.
engagements.coveredHint: The phases and scopes this engagement covers.
engagements.deliverablesHint: What the engagement promises to hand over, and how the client will accept it.
engagements.removeDeliverableConfirm: Remove this deliverable from the engagement?
engagements.draftBanner: Draft: the client doesn't see this project until a signed engagement covers it. The firm admin records it on the client's page.

engagements.pitchBanner: Pitch: firm-only, and seen only by the colleagues on it. Record the signed engagement to make it a client; if it is lost, delete it.
